records.title: Import of Raw Materials for Fertilizers
details: The same way, another scheme is the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for pharmaceuticals and Rs. 15,000 crore have been allocated for that. That promotes the high value drugs of APIs and we are also setting up three bulk drug parks, one in Andhra Pradesh, one in Gujarat, one in Gujarat, and one in Himanchal Pradesh with a common infrastructure to see to it that APSIs are produced here in India.
